mechanism.base: Your core is Metal, and Earth feeds Metal: ore grows in the mountain. Everything solid and patient in your life is the ground your edge is mined from. Sleep, routine, teachers, home: that is Earth doing its slow work on you. That is why Earth is your Mind, the slow intake that restores what the cutting spends. A blade is only ever as good as the mountain behind it.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the mountain goes hungry: a keen edge with nothing behind it, sharpness spent faster than it forms. Your chart asks you to feed the ground. Rest and study are smelting, not stalling.
mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the shelter closes over the blade: so much preparation that the edge never leaves the mine. Comfort begins to bury what it formed. Dig out and cut something real.

function.definition_catalyst:
Earth is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how you take things in: slowly, thoroughly, and for keeps. You learn best with time and repetition, and your judgment gets sharper the longer you sit with a question.

Day to day this looks like being the last to speak and the hardest to argue with. You reread messages before replying, you distrust your own first reactions, and you remember what everyone else has forgotten. People come to you to check things, and they are right to.

The program: give every big decision one night, no exceptions. Read before you decide, and reread before you commit. Once a season, go back over something you were sure about and test whether it still holds.
function.definition_friction:
Earth is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake with no off switch: more courses, more research, more preparing, while the doing keeps waiting. Absorbing starts to feel like progress, and it is the safest way to stand still.

Day to day this looks like seventeen open tabs and no draft, a bookshelf of unopened notebooks, advice collected from everyone and acted on from no one. The next step is already known. Learning more is how you avoid taking it.

The program: set a rule that for every hour you study, you produce something someone else can see. Put a decision date on the thing you keep researching. When you catch yourself starting a new course, finish one old project first.

dips.body: Real rest is part of the studying: sleep and routine are where the layers set.

candidates.cta_verdict: Your mind takes things in slowly and keeps them forever, and your best judgments are the ones you let sit overnight.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Root is your learning function: the seat where the world soaks in and becomes yours. With Earth running it, your mind absorbs like sediment: slowly, in layers, keeping everything that settles. You are slow to learn and nearly impossible to unteach. Give ideas time underground. What forms there comes out ore-grade, load-bearing, and permanently yours.
